cut_her.prompt: Portrait 2:3 frame. A young woman in her early twenties standing still facing the viewer, long straight dark brown hair moving slightly in the wind, a light blue knee-length summer dress with a thin white cardigan, white sneakers, hands holding a small vintage film camera in front of her, a faint sad smile.

cut_her_back.prompt: Portrait 2:3 frame. The same young woman seen completely from behind, long straight dark brown hair and the hem of her light blue summer dress blowing in the wind, a thin white cardigan, barefoot, arms relaxed at her sides, looking into the distance.

cut_him.prompt: Portrait 2:3 frame. A young man in his early twenties seen completely from behind, short messy black hair, a white short-sleeved shirt and dark trousers, hands in his pockets, standing still and looking into the distance.

run_her.prompt: Portrait 2:3 frame. The young woman from the reference image, drawn full body in side view running joyfully to the right with her arms spread out, her long hair and light blue dress flowing behind her; isolated on plain white paper with nothing else drawn.

two.prompt: Square 1:1 frame. The young woman and the young man from the reference images, seen from behind, sitting side by side on a concrete seawall at sunset, her head resting on his shoulder; the calm sea and a huge low sun ahead of them, warm rim light on their hair, long shadows, seagulls far away.

sea.prompt: Square 1:1 frame. A calm summer sea at golden hour seen from a quiet beach, the low sun glittering on gentle waves, distant islands, a few seagulls, towering cumulus clouds on the horizon.

room.prompt: Square 1:1 frame. An empty small Japanese apartment room on a summer morning: a white sheer curtain billowing at an open window, sunlight across the tatami and wooden floor, a folded futon, an old electric fan, cicada-summer mood, telephone wires and blue sky outside.

pyramid.prompt: Square 1:1 frame. The glass pyramid of the Louvre museum in Paris at blue hour, glowing warm from inside and reflected in the still fountain pools, the palace wings with lit windows, a deep blue sky with the first stars.

sky.prompt: Square 1:1 frame. Looking up into a brilliant deep blue summer sky with towering white cumulonimbus clouds, a utility pole and power lines crossing the frame from one corner, sun glare and lens flare at the edge.

road.prompt: Square 1:1 frame. An empty countryside road at dusk running straight to the horizon between rice paddies that reflect the sky, a row of wooden utility poles and sagging power lines, the sky burning orange fading to violet, a single streetlight flickering on.

bokeh.prompt: Square 1:1 frame. City lights at night seen through a rain-streaked window, the city melted into large round bokeh circles of amber, rose and teal, rain droplets on the glass in crisp focus.

field.prompt: Square 1:1 frame. A summer meadow of tall grass and small wildflowers backlit by the golden afternoon sun, dandelion seeds floating in the air, a far line of trees and one lonely power pylon.

train.prompt: Square 1:1 frame. Inside an empty local commuter train carriage in the late afternoon, warm sunlight pouring through the windows across the long bench seats and swaying hanging straps, glowing dust in the air, the landscape outside bright.

moon.prompt: Square 1:1 frame. A pale full moon rising over quiet tiled rooftops, a water tower and power lines at twilight, deep blue sky, one small warmly lit window below.

lamp.prompt: Square 1:1 frame. A warm desk lamp glowing at night over an open diary, a vintage film camera, a few printed photographs and a cassette player on a wooden desk, the rest of the room in soft blue darkness, a window with the night city.

white.prompt: Square 1:1 frame. An overexposed, almost white frame: the young woman and the young man from the reference images, seen from behind, standing close together and dissolving into a flood of bright light; washed-out pastel peach and pale blue, strong halation bloom, an orange film light leak along one edge.

hero.prompt: Square 1:1 frame, the emotional key frame of the film. The young woman and the young man from the reference images, seen from behind, standing close together and holding hands at the end of a long straight road that leads toward a huge low setting sun; their silhouettes are rimmed with golden light, power lines cross the sky, the sky shades from deep violet at the top through rose to gold at the horizon, soft lens flare streaks; a quiet, loving, bittersweet moment of farewell.

platform.prompt: Wide 16:9 landscape frame. Dusk at a small quiet Japanese countryside railway station, the camera stands on one platform and looks straight across the two empty tracks at the opposite platform, which runs horizontally across the middle of the frame: a small roofed shelter with a lit fluorescent lamp, a wooden bench, a glowing vending machine, a blank station name board, overhead catenary wires, hills and utility poles behind; the sky deep blue-violet fading to a thin orange band at the horizon; the near platform edge with its yellow tactile line runs along the bottom of the frame. Completely empty, no train.

redsea.prompt: Wide 16:9 landscape frame. A surreal endless sea of deep crimson red water, perfectly still like a mirror, stretching to a flat horizon under a dark starry sky; a huge pale white planet hangs low above the horizon and is mirrored in the red water; a faint pale path of light on the water leads toward it; silent, eerie, apocalyptic and beautiful, like the end of the world. No land.

trainwin.prompt: Wide 16:9 landscape frame. Inside a dark night train carriage looking at a large window: outside, the lights of the city and street lamps stream past in long motion-blurred streaks of amber and cyan, faint reflections of the empty lit carriage on the glass, the dark window frame, seat backs and a hanging strap in the foreground.

clouds.prompt: Wide 16:9 landscape frame. High above a boundless sea of billowing clouds at twilight, towering cumulus shapes lit softly from below, the sky above clear, luminous and vast, pale lilac, peach and rose tones, a few early stars, dreamlike open space. No ground.

meadow.prompt: Wide 16:9 landscape drawing. A wide summer meadow of tall grass and wildflowers under a big open sky with a round sun and a few soft clouds, a small path winding through the field toward low distant hills; the upper half is mostly open sky and white paper.

viewfinder.prompt: Wide 16:9 frame, slightly out of focus as if seen through a camera lens. The young woman from the reference image sits by a bright window in warm afternoon light and raises her open hand toward the camera to hide her face, laughing shyly; her palm covers her eyes, only her smile, hair and shoulders are visible; soft backlight, a small room with photographs on the wall.
